Reading the notebook

Looking again may reveal a detail that was easy to miss. These sentences remain ordinary body text even when a nearby date or caption uses the quieter secondary colour.

Keep a record

  • Write down what changed between the morning and afternoon visits.
  • Compare the new observation with the earlier entry before adding a conclusion.
